title: POST /v1/embed request (document-intelligence.v1)
description: application/json body: request-metadata keys plus a required `projection` object carrying only the canonical document-structure-embedding.v1 projection. The optional X-Operation-Generation header must equal operationGeneration when both are present.

mediaType.description: Optional on embedding; capability admission still gates the effective media catalog.

languageHint.description: Optional; must be in the admitted language catalog (default en, ne).

projection.description: Canonical document-structure-embedding.v1 projection; opaque to the envelope grammar.
